units.source_text: 明治维新以后，京都城内外的古老寺庙所以很少被焚，就是这种素质的赏赐。

en.t: After the Meiji Restoration, the old temples inside and outside Kyoto were rarely burned down; that was the gift of this quality.

units.source_text: 即使偶然失火，火也会被踩灭、被分截，乃至被管理的。

en.t: Even if a fire broke out by chance, it would be stamped out, cut off, and even brought under control.
In earlier times, it was by no means like this.

units.source_text: 知思院在永享三年失火，其后还多次征受人劫。

en.t: Chishiin caught fire in the third year of Eikyo, and afterward suffered human calamities many more times.

units.source_text: 明德四年，南禅寺本院的佛殿、法堂、金刚殿、大云庵等都失过火。

en.t: In the fourth year of Meitoku, the Buddha hall, lecture hall, Kongo hall, Daiun-an, and other buildings of Nanzenji's main temple all suffered fires.

units.source_text: 延历寺在元龟二年化为灰烬。

en.t: Enryakuji was reduced to ashes in the second year of Genki.

units.source_text: 建仁寺在天文二十一年罹难于战火。

en.t: Kenninji fell victim to the flames of war in the twenty-first year of Tenbun.

units.source_text: 三十三间堂在建长元年毁于一旦。

en.t: Sanjusangendo was destroyed in a single day in the first year of Kencho.

units.source_text: 本能寺则在天正十年的兵荒马乱中焚毁……

en.t: Honnoji, for its part, burned down amid the turmoil of war in the tenth year of Tensho...
